name: Securities Balance 3
definition: Quantity of securities assigned as collateral position.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument at the time of the preparation of the statement. It is the resulting balance of securities post movements for delta (reporting on flow).

CollateralIndicator.name: Collateral Indicator
CollateralIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the financial instrument is delivered/received as collateral or as loaned  securities.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Account from which the collateral is sourced.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account where financial instruments are maintained. It is the source account.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

SettlementStatus.name: Settlement Status
SettlementStatus.definition: Provides the status of settlement of an instruction.

DenominationCurrency.name: Denomination Currency
DenominationCurrency.definition: Currency  in which a security is issued or redenominated.

RatingDetails.name: Rating Details
RatingDetails.definition: Rating and source of the rating of the financial instrument.

ForeignExchangeDetails.name: Foreign Exchange Details
ForeignExchangeDetails.definition: Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.

ValuationDetails.name: Valuation Details
ValuationDetails.definition: Valuation details for the securities position.

TransactionLotNumber.name: Transaction Lot Number
TransactionLotNumber.definition: Identification of the underlying market value lots based on the term of the underlyning trades. The issuer defines the lot identification.

CollateralFlagYesSettlementDateRule.definition: If collateral indicator is set to Y the  settlement date in the valuations details must be present.

CollateralFlagNoSettlementDateRule.definition: If collateral flag is set to N, the settlement date in the valuation details  cannot be present.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.
